lessons.title: Getting Started & Language Focus
objectives: Nắm vững các khái niệm và định nghĩa cốt lõi của Getting Started & Language Focus.
Hiểu và áp dụng thành thạo các quy tắc và công thức trong SGK 12.
Rèn luyện kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết các bài toán/tình huống thực tiễn ôn thi THPT & ĐGNL.

concepts.definition: Past continuous describes an action in progress in the past when another shorter action (Past simple) interrupted it: When S + V(past simple), S + was/were V-ing; or While S + was/were V-ing, S + V(past simple).
concepts.example: While Uncle Ho was working abroad, he traveled to many countries to find a way to liberate Vietnam.
concepts.essence: Expressing background context and specific interrupting events in historical narrative.

concepts.definition: Adjectives formed by joining two or more words (often with a hyphen) such as well-known, warm-hearted, hard-working, open-minded.
concepts.example: General Vo Nguyen Giap was a world-famous military strategist admired by people globally.
concepts.essence: Enriching descriptions of character traits and personal achievements concisely.

rules.statement: Usage of While and When with Past tenses
rules.meaning: Use 'While' before continuous long actions (While + Past Continuous); use 'When' before sudden short actions (When + Past Simple) or concurrent events.
rules.example: When I arrived home, my family was having dinner.
rules.essence: Time relationships must match the aspectual nature of the events.

workedExamples.prompt: Combine two sentences using 'when' or 'while': 'Isaac Newton was sitting under an apple tree.' and 'An apple fell on his head.'
steps: Step 1: Identify the continuous background action: sitting under an apple tree -> Past Continuous.
Step 2: Identify the short interrupting action: an apple fell -> Past Simple.
Step 3: Combine with 'while': While Isaac Newton was sitting under an apple tree, an apple fell on his head.
Step 4: Alternative with 'when': Isaac Newton was sitting under an apple tree when an apple fell on his head.
workedExamples.answer: While Isaac Newton was sitting under an apple tree, an apple fell on his head.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Past Continuous for stative verbs: *While I was knowing the answer*.
commonMistakes.why: Stative verbs (know, understand, believe, love) are not used in continuous aspect; use Past Simple instead: While I knew the answer.
